rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description:
Official Miro MCP server that gives AI agents secure access to your Miro boards. Enables bidirectional workflows between code and visual collaboration:

- **Diagram generation** — Create flowcharts, sequence diagrams, ERDs, and other visual representations from code, PRDs, or text descriptions
- **Code generation** — Convert Miro board designs, mockups, and diagrams into functional code
- **Board context** — Read board content to provide AI assistants with rich organizational context
- **Task sync** — Synchronize tasks between AI conversations and Miro tables

Supports OAuth 2.1 authentication with enterprise compliance features. Available as a hosted remote server at `https://mcp.miro.com/` — no local installation required.
